card.headline_en: Call 999 or go to A&E now
card.headline_zh: 请立即拨打 999 或前往急诊室
card.body_en: Your symptoms need urgent medical attention.
card.body_zh: 您的症状需要紧急医疗护理。
card.maternity_note_en: If this is an urgent pregnancy concern, also call your maternity unit or triage line now — the number is on your maternity notes.
card.maternity_note_zh: 如果这是紧急的孕期问题，请立即拨打您的产科病房或分诊电话——号码在您的产检记录上。
card.disclaimer: This is not medical advice. Always confirm with your midwife or doctor.
